note: preset handle. Matter octet handle encoding (value_kind text): byte to text writes each octet as two lowercase hexadecimal digits (0-9a-f), high nibble first, in order, with no prefix and no separator; text to bytes accepts only an even-length string of those digits and rejects uppercase, an odd length, a prefix, a separator, and any other character; empty octets encode as empty text and empty text decodes as empty octets; a null Matter handle is omitted and is not empty text; round-trip example octets 00 01 7f 80 ff 0a encode as 00017f80ff0a and decode to those same six bytes. Not a human-readable name. A Matter handle cited as octstr with constraint max 16 stays at most 16 octets.
